title: Hosted CI for P05.3 is configured after P05.4
decision: The hosted-CI Validation carrier of P05.3 (D73 п.4, D76: push of the item commit and a green run, `origin` or the owner-redirected mirror) is not run now. The owner configures hosted CI after P05.4 and executes P05.4 in a separate session. Local Validation of P05.3 is green and the independent review is recorded, but `plan-lint` (D76) forbids closing an item whose `pre_final` is not `allow`, so P05.3 stays `In progress` until either that carrier has a receipt (a green hosted run on a commit that contains `a59c38b2`) or the owner amends the carrier in the item spec under a new decision and design-audit waiver. The deferral changes nothing else: every other carrier, the review result and the empty allowlist/baseline rules stay binding.
rationale: The owner postponed the hosted-CI setup (the `origin` account cannot start jobs; the mirror needs an explicit push) and asked to record the status in the plan. Closing the item with a missing carrier would be a green claim the evidence does not support.
